senses.gloss: --one of Danu's sons. वा. ६८. 9.

--servants entertained in a श्राद्ध;
1: M. १७. ५७ and ६२; वा. ६०. ३७.
appellation of the शूद्रस्.
2: Vi. III. १०. 9.
--रावन killed by राम. भा. II. 7. २३-25.
--the याम gan2as who stand in ten parts in the वैराज. वा. १०१. ६४.

(I)--रावन (s.v.).
1: भा. VII. १०. ३६; Br. III. 7. २६२; ७१ 159.
शिशुपाल in previous birth.
2: वा. ९६. १५३.
(II)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्य- कशिपु. M. १६१. ८१.
--the images of राम and Bali. M. २५९. 1.
--a northern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ४८.
(I)--a son of मूलक, and father of ऐड- विड. (इलीविल-वि। प्।). भा. IX. 9. ४१; V. IV. 4. ७५.

(II)--a son of Aja (पाल) and of इन्दुमती; and father of श्री Ra1ma (दाशरथि Ra1ma-वा। प्।) and three other sons, being the अम्शस् of Hari.
1: भा. IX. १०. 1-2; Br. III. ६३. १८४; IV. ४०. १००; M. १२. ४९-50; वा. ८८. १८३-4; १११. ६४; Vi. IV. 4. ८६-7.
A friend of Roma- पाद to whom he gave his daughter शान्ता in adoption.
2: भा. IX. २३. 7-8; Vi. IV. १८. १७-8.
King of अयोध्या. Having no sons worshipped त्रिपुरसुन्दरी at the capital and spent seven days at काञ्ची praying to कामाक्षी who blessed him with four sons.
3: Br. III. ३७. ३१; ६३. १८४; IV. ४०. ८८.
(III)--a son of Navaratha, and father of शकुनि (एकादशरथ-ब्र्। प्।). भा. IX. २४. 4-5; Br. III. ७०. ४३-4. वा. ९५. ४२; Vi. IV. १२. ४१.
(IV)--a son of Satyaratha (Citraratha: वा। प्।). (Known also as लोमपाद). M. ४८. ९४; वा. 9. १०३.
(V)--a Maurya king who ruled for eight years; son of सुयशा and father of Samyuta. M. २७२. २५; Vi. IV. २४. ३०.
--the bow of शिव with ten colours. वा. १०१. २७०. [page२-079+ ३३]
--a Vindhya tribe enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus. भा. X. [५०. (v) 3]; Br. II. १६. ६४; वा. ४५. १३२.
--शतध्वज (s.v.) was their king; when they heard of कृष्ण going to मिथिला they met him with presents. भा. X. ५२. ११ [१२]; ८६. २५.
--a R. in भारतवर्ष from the र्क्ष; sacred to पितृस्. Br. II. १६. ३०; III. १३. १००; M. २२. ३४; वा. ४५. ९९. M. १४४. २५.

(I)--the son of निर्वृत्(t)i, (निधृति-व्। प्।, वीदूरथ, म्। प्।), and father of Vyoma;
1: भा. IX. २४. 3; X. ३६. ३३; M. ४४. ४०.
a man of much prowess.
2: Br. III. ७०. ४१; Vi. IV. १२. ४१.
(II)--a son of घर्मात्मा. वा. ९५. ४०.
--see दशार्हस्. भा. XI. ३०. १८.

--(also दशार्हकास्) a tribe related to the पाण्- डवस्. They defended द्वारका when attacked.
1: भा. I. ११. ११; १४. २५; III. 1. २९.
Praised कृष्ण's heroism.
2: Ib. IX. २४. ६३.
Felt relieved at Kamsa's death as they heard of his plan to vanquish them.
3: Ib. X. ३६. ३३; ३९. २५; ४५. १५.
Followed बलराम to द्वारका and fought their own kinsmen.
4: Ib. X. ६१. ४०; XI. २९. ३९; ३०. १८.
--a तीर्थ on the नर्मदा; west of गन्गेश्वरम्. १९३. २०-2.

--a Tirtham in Benares;
1: M. १८५. ६८.
fit for श्राद्ध.
2: वा. ७७. ४५.
[page२-080+ ३०]
--a northern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ५०.

--the name of Budha, son of तारा and Soma who forcibly seized her from बृहस्पति;
1: Br. III. ६५. ४१; वा. ९०. ३७.
called Budha after तारा revealed his real father.
2: वा. ९०. ४३.
--an आन्गिरस and मन्त्रकृत्. Br. II. ३२. १०८.
--here were born as hunters the seven sons of कौशिक. But they remembered their previous births and refrained from cruel deeds. M. २०. १२-4; २१. 9 and २८.
--a name of राम, who destroyed रावन and his clan. वा. ७०. ४८.
--the fisher-woman, who took birth as सत्यवती and begot विचित्रवीर्य by शन्तनु. M. ५०. ४५; वा. ७३. २१; ९९. २४०.
(I)--Slaves as present to learned men. Br. II. ३४. ३९. [page२-086+ २९]

(II)--of four kinds, देवदासि, ब्रह्मदासि, स्व- तन्त्र and शूद्रदासिक; the first two occupy the status of a क्षत्रिय lady; the third enjoys the status of a dancing girl (वेशि), and the last that of a low caste (हीनजाति).
1: Br. IV. 8. ११-12.
A synonym of परिचारिक or a servant-maid.
2: M. २९. १७-23.
--a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८५.
